sentences.en: My wife went to the powder room to freshen up.
sentences.zh: 1. 我妻子去化妆室补妆了。

sentences.en: There was some kind of white powder on the floor.
sentences.zh: 2. 地上有一些白色的粉末。

sentences.en: Is Algeria really a huge powder keg ready to blow?
sentences.zh: 3. 阿尔及利亚真的像一个随时可能爆炸的火药桶吗？

senses.zh: 粉；粉末；[化工][军] 火药；尘土
